newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH ACADEMICS' UNION WANTS TAX CUTS FOR ALL.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH ACADEMICS' UNION WANTS TAX CUTS FOR ALL.

text.p: The Confederation of Unions for Academic Professionals in Finland (AKAVA) said on Tuesday it wanted lower income tax rates for all groups of earners, and that it supported government efforts to keep inflation low.

"AKAVA supports the government's efforts to help employment with a policy aiming at low inflation and a stable economic growth," it said in a statement, adding however that income taxes in Finland were too high and should be lowered.
"AKAVA proposes to the government which is preparing for budget talks a reduction in state income taxes in all income groups," it said.
